what: the 1217 count plateau: its two directions, its three walls, and their status

base.meaning: the arc D lift; moves the 6th cube

third_wall.note: successive differences 0.225,0.240,0.255,0.272 -- not constant. An earlier straight-line fit from two grid points was wrong by ~0.17 at b=1/2.
third_wall.provenance_down: CANNOT exist at n=6: the group needs cube 6, which is absent
third_wall.provenance_up: present and bounding at n=8 in the same place -- 1895 at tau=53/100, 1891 at 54/100, the same bracket and the same drop of 4 as at n=7
third_wall.mechanism: the group mentions only cubes 0,5,6, so cubes added later neither move it nor change its cost

a_wall_crossed_with_no_count_change.note: the same ray crosses this first; the count does not change. See P298.

CAVEATS: the two direction extents are brackets, not solved
combination extents beyond the solved cut are not measured
whether n=8 has further walls of its own was not tested
condition keys name cube INDICES; they are comparable across levels only when those indices denote the same cubes (cube 7 differs at n=8 and n=9)

inheritance.measured: n=7 -> n=8 -> n=9 (n=9 keeps the 1217 seven, dropping n=8 eighth cube)

tight_conditions.note: near-automatic: tightness depends only on the cubes in the group, so extension cannot disturb it

base_arcD.note: the shared bracket (-1/50,-1/25) was coarseness; the walls differ by 60% in t
base_arcD.n7: no wall in (-0.06,-0.012); the plateau runs to -2/19

inheritance.criterion: a boundary is inherited iff no new condition is crossed earlier in that direction; readable from which cubes the direction moves versus which the added cubes constrain
inheritance.open: whether n=8 and n=9 share the same contracting wall -- same bracket (-1/50,-1/25), different added cubes, neither solved

walls_crossed_without_count_change.tally: 4 of 6 wall crossings measured leave the count unchanged (see P298)
